name: Pair-twined basketry at Kfar Samir
description: Three twig basket fragments from the central sector of submerged Kfar Samir preserve alternate pair-twining. Excavators found them in a clay-filled pit containing olive stones and wood fragments.

places.note: Kfar Samir, central sector, Carmel coast.

date.label: Site context approximately 7964–6299 cal BP
date.basis: Rosenberg and colleagues, Table 1, date KS 2 by the site. The outer bounds combine different dated site samples, with cal BP converted to BCE using the 1950 reference.

events.statement: Waterlogged basket fragments catalogued as KS 2 preserve alternate pair-twining and were deposited in a pit with olive stones.

evidence.supports: The surviving form and weave are described directly. The assigned age derives from the site context.

earliest_record.rationale: Dated site context of the observed technique in the KS 2 fragments.

caveats: The basket has an indirect site date. Rosenberg and colleagues suggest that it could have held olives during oil extraction. Its function remains uncertain.
